preconditions.description: Both strings s and t consist only of lowercase English letters.
Both strings s and t are non-empty.
The length of each string does not exceed 2·10^5.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Yes' if all(any(s[i] == t[j] for j in range(len(t))) for i in range(len(s))) else return_value == 'No'
postconditions.description: The output is 'Yes' if each character of string s occurs in at least one subsequence of s that coincides with string t, otherwise 'No'.
